results.name: NHMW Cookie Plate
results.description:
Christmas is just around the corner and the streets of Vienna are very busy at this time of the year. The Christmas markets are open, it smells of punch and mulled wine and all kinds of sweets, our parks are decorated with fairy lights. Could there be a better time for the 3D lab of the NHM Vienna to present a small collection of cookie cutters?

Viola Winkler created ready to 3D print cookie cutters, that are free to download at [Thingiverse](https://www.thingiverse.com/nhmwien/), [Printables](https://www.printables.com/@NaturalHistor_871675) or here on Sketchfab by choosing "Additional file" when downloading.

1. [Venus of Willendorf](https://bit.ly/3EWsEu7)
2. [Apple blossom](https://bit.ly/3ymByP8)
4. [Dodo bird](https://bit.ly/3IZDaU7)
4. [Old World swallowtail](https://bit.ly/3m3QDjI)
5. [Green tree phyton](https://bit.ly/3DU2OWc)
6. [Terror bird](https://bit.ly/3GGO0w3)
7. [DNA double helix](https://bit.ly/3EUPPoK)
8. [Rock crystal](https://bit.ly/3yCEOWZ)

Scanned and edited by Anna Haider (NHMW).

results.name: Christmas Decoration Small Table Tree
results.description:
Bring a touch of rustic holiday charm to your digital scene with this lovely miniature Christmas tree. Designed as a small table centerpiece, this 3D model features a delicate, conical frame richly covered in green moss and tiny needles, giving it an organic, handcrafted look.

The tree is beautifully decorated with a string of bright, white 'airy lights that adds a festive glow. It stands on a natural, round wooden base scattered with additional fairy lights and small green fallen needles, completing the cozy, festive aesthetic. Perfect warm interior scenes / renders, seasonal interior visualizations, or creating a warm, charming holiday atmosphere.

Free to download.

Support, .blend file and more information available on Superhive ... [Christmas Decoration Small Table Tree](http://superhivemarket.com/products/christmas-decoration-small-table-tree?ref=6573)

results.name: NHMW Tree Ornaments
results.description:
The streets of Vienna are very busy during X-Mas time. The winter markets are open, it smells of punch, mulled wine and all kinds of sweets, our parks are decorated with fairy lights. We made three tree ornaments for your tree to print at home.

Viola Winkler (NHMW) created different "ready to 3D print" tree ornaments, that are free to download at [Thingiverse](https://www.thingiverse.com/nhmwien/), [Printables](https://printables.com/@NaturalHistor_871675) and here on Sketchfab if you select "Additional file" when downloading.

1. [Seated Idol of Pazarzhik](https://printables.com/model/847991-tree-ornament-of-seated-idol-of-pazarzhik)

2. [Megalodon Tooth](https://printables.com/model/848047-megalodon-tooth-tree-ornament)

3. [Three-Banded Armadillo](https://printables.com/model/848044-tree-ornament-armadillo)


Infrastructure funded by the FFG.

The designs are based on 3D models from this account and were designed by Viola Winkler.

Scanned and edited by Anna Haider & Viola Winkler (NHMW).

results.name: Christmas tree 3
results.description: In the heart of a festive home, a majestic fir tree commands attention, its lush branches adorned with an exquisite array of ornaments. Every limb of the tree is meticulously adorned—glittering baubles suspended like captured stars, delicate glass ornaments reflecting the soft glow of fairy lights, and strands of tinsel elegantly draped, casting shimmering reflections around the room. The tree, a symphony of colors and textures, stands as a beacon of holiday cheer, its greenery a canvas for the artistry of decorations. Its presence transforms the space, infusing it with warmth and an unmistakable air of magic, inviting all to revel in the enchantment of the season.

results.name: Evil Halloween Pumpkin Jack-o'-Lantern
results.description:
Bring Halloween to life with this spooky Jack-o'-Lantern pumpkin! 🎃
This 3D printable model is hollow inside, so you can place an LED light, fairy lights, or even a small candle to create a terrifying glow from its eyes, nose, and sharp-toothed grin.

Perfect as a Halloween decoration for your home, party, or garden. The design includes:

Evil pumpkin face with sharp teeth 😈

Hollow interior for safe lighting

Printable in one piece
"works great with LED tea lights (safe alternative to candles)"

You can scale it up or down to fit your Halloween setup. Whether for a table centerpiece, porch light, or spooky décor, this pumpkin will surely impress trick-or-treaters and guests!

results.name: Clive the Clumsy Crocodile Intern
results.description:
This 3D model was created for DD20023- 3D Character Modelling. 

This character is a clumsy crocodile who is constantly playful at work, and usually enticed by the nightlife at the Darul Hana Bridge, which is his workplace. Being the playful self that he is, he has a chain of fairy lights curled around his tail to chime in with the night life at the bridge.
